importerOrder.name: CSS custom-property tokens and scope rules
importerOrder.proposal: Extract declarations, aliases, fallbacks, selectors, layers, media/supports conditions and source order. Preserve unresolved calc/color values and theme scopes; do not flatten all definitions into one map.

importerOrder.name: Structured token input: JSON/JSON5, DTCG extensions and Style Dictionary lineage
importerOrder.proposal: Recognize $type/$value as well as legacy value objects, aliases and composite values. Preserve vendor extensions and generated/source relationships. Handle Carbon’s per-theme extension and Primer’s JSON5 before claiming generic DTCG coverage.

importerOrder.name: Restricted TS/JS token objects and Tailwind theme adapters
importerOrder.proposal: Read literal objects, imports, spreads and simple aliases statically. Add Tailwind config and CSS @theme mappings. Keep factory/derivative functions as executable dependencies with unresolved outputs instead of evaluating arbitrary repository code during discovery.

importerOrder.name: Sass maps, generation and artifact linking
importerOrder.proposal: Extract !default settings, maps, imports and generator inputs. Link published CSS/JS artifacts to definitions; treat compile-dependent values as unresolved until a controlled build is supplied.

importerOrder.name: React component records and variant adapters
importerOrder.proposal: Discover package exports and TS/TSX modules; capture props, defaults, slots, polymorphism, controlled state, refs and style dependencies. Implement union/class-map, cva, prop-definition and recipe adapters without claiming visual equivalence from matching names.

importerOrder.name: Stories, docs and preview composition
importerOrder.proposal: Parse Storybook CSF args/decorators, MDX and component doc metadata first, then custom TSX examples and registry entries. Missing stories require a preview recipe or consumer fixture; a docs page is not automatically a runnable isolated story.

importerOrder.name: Runtime styling resolution and non-React targets
importerOrder.proposal: Keep Emotion/Griffel providers, caches, transforms and generated CSS as explicit preview dependencies. Extend the record for Nunjucks macro schemas and Lit custom-element metadata after the React path works on real product repos.

componentRecord.coverageCriterion: The core record can describe React source plus opaque style/build/theme dependencies; it does not require a new HTML-template or custom-element target extension. This is representational coverage, not successful parsing, rendering, accessibility or automatic re-theming.

fields.name: identity
fields.description: Repository URL, immutable SHA, package/version, entrypoint/export, module path, component family/part, framework, license scope and source evidence.

fields.name: publicAPI
fields.description: Props/type sources, unions, defaults, generics, events, children/slots, ref target, controlled/uncontrolled pairs and polymorphic render/as/asChild rules.

fields.name: structure
fields.description: Root element and named parts, composition/dependency edges, required contexts/providers, accessibility/state hooks and inherited/native attributes.

fields.name: styles
fields.description: Source style files, engine, class/slot/data-selector contracts, generated artifacts, build transforms, cascade order and unresolved runtime dependencies.

fields.name: tokens
fields.description: Original format and raw nodes, semantic roles, alias edges, primitive/composite types, mode/scale/contrast dimensions, conditions, generated/source lineage and unresolved expressions.

fields.name: variants
fields.description: Independent axes, legal values, defaults, compounds, responsive values, per-slot mappings and state-dependent styles; keep behavior props separate from appearance choices.

fields.name: theme
fields.description: Provider and selector scope, light/dark/system preference, override and merge semantics, CSS entrypoints and initialization/SSR requirements.

fields.name: preview
fields.description: Story/module/export/route, args and argTypes, decorators/providers, fixture data, assets/fonts, routing and environment requirements; explicit not-found state when stories are absent.

fields.name: documentation
fields.description: MDX/Markdown/TSX/JSON/YAML source links, API metadata, examples, lifecycle/deprecation and usage notes retained as source evidence.

extensions.description: Macro parameters, template path, YAML fixtures, JS enhancement module and Sass build inputs.
Custom-element tag, element properties/attributes/events, slots, shadow DOM styles, Sass tokens and Lit preview definitions.

hardCases.name: Generated and separately versioned tokens
hardCases.description: Source token formats, dependency versions and emitted CSS must remain distinct. Primer’s supporting source is pinned independently; Spectrum imports external token JSON; Carbon and Atlassian generate artifacts.

hardCases.name: Vendor mode extensions
hardCases.description: A DTCG-looking file can store mode values in custom extensions, while JS themes can compute them. A schema label alone is insufficient to resolve every token.

hardCases.name: Runtime and compiled CSS-in-JS
hardCases.description: Style functions can depend on theme, props and runtime state; build-time extraction/macro transforms require the original toolchain. Record opaque dependencies before attempting normalization.

hardCases.name: Scope and cascade
hardCases.description: Nested providers, classes, data attributes, media conditions and scale parameters change resolution. Preserve these conditions and source order rather than deduplicating equal variable names.

hardCases.name: Unstyled behavior packages
hardCases.description: Base UI and React Aria can supply behavior without a prescribed visual token set. Documentation themes must not be mistaken for required library tokens.

hardCases.name: Registry source and product drift
hardCases.description: A source registry contains bases/styles/dependency metadata; products own local copies that may acquire wrappers, new variants and different theme initialization.

hardCases.name: Preview formats are heterogeneous
hardCases.description: CSF is only one input. TSX docs/examples, route-based playgrounds, YAML fixtures and Lit stories need adapters; the three product clones have no conventional Storybook paths.

hardCases.name: Counts and compound components
hardCases.description: Public module, documented family, registry item and custom-element tag counts differ. Keep the explicit counting scope and full member paths; do not compare totals as interchangeable library sizes.

hardCases.name: License granularity
hardCases.description: Repository roots, individual files, vendored UI and enterprise packages can have different terms. Preserve declarations at their actual scope; this survey does not determine reuse permissions.
